component.name: Kurgu
component.summary: Özgür ve açık kaynak video düzenleyici

description.p: Kurgu is a professional, cross-platform non-linear video editor.
Kurgu, profesyonel ve platformlar arası bir doğrusal olmayan video düzenleyicidir.

ul.li: Multi-track timeline with ripple, roll, slip and slide tools
Source monitor, multi-camera editing with audio sync
Lumetri-style color correction with curves, color wheels and scopes
Masks, blend modes, track mattes, keyframes and transitions
Automatic captions (Whisper), audio mixer and loudness normalization
Export presets including H.265 10-bit and ProRes
